column3: Socratic refinement into an approved design
Isolated workspace on a feature branch
One task at a time, verifying each before the next
RED then GREEN then REFACTOR for every behaviour change
Self-review the diff against the plan
Verify, decide the merge, clean up the branch
Log lessons, promote patterns, update the memory vault
